entry.title: Allied Cases — Independent Corroboration
entry.content:
Independent litigants are identifying the same judicial misconduct patterns documented in the Banks enterprise investigation. Allied cases create triangulation — no single complaint can be dismissed as one “disgruntled litigant.”

Filed2026

  • Bryant independently identified Judge Cylenthia Miller as a problem
  • Same judge who served as Board Chair of Banks’ Anchor Rock Foundation
  • Same judge under JTC complaint
  • Same judge up for election November 3, 2026
  • A second, independent litigant corroborates the pattern of judicial misconduct

Triangulation with Federal Packet and JTC Complaints

Bryant’s case establishes that Miller’s misconduct is not isolated to one litigant. When combined with:

SourceConnection

Federal packet documenting Miller’s board service for Banks Anchor Rock Foundation connection
JTC complaintsEthical violations — airport gun, infant murder dismissal, practicing law while judge
Institutional Capture analysisMiller as captured court actor

…it creates a triangulation that no single case can be dismissed as a “disgruntled litigant.”

See also: RICO Pattern — judicial cover layer.

PCA Board ChairBanks’ newest charter school
Baker College colleagueTaught Criminal Justice alongside Banks (fake J.D.)
Attorney: Todd Perkins Banks’ attorney — see Judge Sean Perkins

Miller sits at the intersection of courts, schools, and the Banks network. Bryant’s independent identification of Miller validates the pattern analysis across multiple unrelated sources.

36th District Court — Bradley-Baskin 📰 Reported Indictment (Context)

The 36th District Court — where three Banks-network judges sit ( Judge Tenisha Yancey , Judge Adam Sabree , Judge Sean Perkins ) — is also where Judge Andrea Bradley-Baskin was federally indicted in January 2026 for allegedly embezzling hundreds of thousands of dollars from incapacitated wards.

FieldDetail

ChargesConspiracy to commit wire fraud, money laundering, false statement to federal agent
AllegationsUsed $70,000 in ward funds for bar ownership stake; ward-estate money for Ford Expedition lease
StatusRemoved from docket; pleaded not guilty

This is not a Banks-network connection. Bradley-Baskin is a separate judge on the same court. The indictment establishes the broader institutional environment — a court where fiduciary abuse of vulnerable wards is alleged at the judicial level.

Sources: 🏛️ DOJ : USAO-EDMI press release , 📰 Free Press : Jan 30, 2026

His office controls Wayne County’s tax foreclosure pipeline — the same land where Judge Judge Tenisha Yancey worked (Wayne County Land Bank, 2007–2013) and where distressed properties become acquisition opportunities.

The class action alleges systemic constitutional violations in how the Treasurer’s office handles tax foreclosures — the same office whose leader is a documented campaign endorser of Judge Cylenthia Miller (per keepjudgemiller.com).

See: Eric Sabree profile, Institutional Capture — Housing.
